verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a pricing-page line listing "sequences" as a plan feature (attio-docs-70), so Attio appears to ship a sequences capability, but nothing describes how it works. AI drafting of follow-ups and the Workflows builder's 'sequences of automated actions' are related but are not documented email templating or sending, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of email templates, multi-step sequence configuration (steps, delays, stop conditions), sending from a connected mailbox inside the CRM, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM
